$comment: BASELINE — captured before phase 1a reached production, which is the only
reason it is worth anything. Taken through the user's own profiled Chrome
(the only transport Google does not block; see the phase-3 design), 10 queries
in one sitting, no block encountered.
METHOD LIMITATION, recorded because it bit during this very capture: detecting
'cited inside the AI Overview' by DOM containment gives false positives — the
matched container wrapped both the overview and the organic results, so a link
1880px below the overview read as cited. Position is the reliable signal: the
link's absolute top versus the overview block's bottom. The one apparent hit
here (sun-nyc-sep) was refuted that way and is organic, far below the fold.
Also note aioBottom clusters at ~208px because the smallest element containing
the label is the label itself, not the whole block. Good enough to separate
'in the overview' from 'two thousand pixels down', which is the distinction that
mattered here, but the phase-3 analyser should bound the block properly.

observations.note: No AI Overview at all — the first counterexample to the 5/5 sample of 2026-08-09.
Containment check said cited; position refuted it. Organic, below the fold.
We were present organically on 2026-08-09 and absent today — day-to-day SERP variance, worth watching before reading any single reading as a trend.

competitors.$comment: How often each appears across the 10 queries. The comparison that matters is alpenglow: a small app, cited where we are not.
